title: 第21章  海城黑市第22章  黑市进货
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
“这不太好吧，老师。”
夜离殇扑闪一下眼眸，嘴上说着不好，但伸手的速度却一点都不慢。
“没什么不好的。”
“你是学院中唯一一名s级御兽师天赋的学生，到时候其他班级的人，估计也会多注意你的。”
“老师对你的要求也不高，只要秘境排名能进前十就行。”
凌沧海的表情很认真。
嗯～
整个七班中，天赋最好的也就是夜离殇了。
除了夜离殇以外，天赋最好的也就是几个c级天赋的学生，指望那几名c级天赋的学生进入前十，凌沧海感觉不太现实，不如把希望都放在夜离殇的身上。
s级的御兽师天赋，再加上七个班级的学生都是新生的缘故，夜离殇在其中的优势还是很大的。
再加上夜离殇的云绒狐现在是三级，稳稳站在新生中的前列，只要这几天好好努力，正常情况下，凌沧海觉得夜离殇坐三争二望一的可能性还是很大的。
当然了，这只是正常情况下，不排除其他班级的学生们，为了排名故意针对的情况。
“嗯，到时候我会努力的。”
夜离殇轻轻点头，目光在名单上一一扫过。
一班的人中，有一个名叫千凝的人，所拥有的御兽和她的一样都是三级，其余人的御兽都是二级，单从御兽的等级来看，其余人要比她低一点点。
“到时候加油，老师看好你。”
凌沧海鼓励了一句后，就往前方走去，观看第一个人的训练情况。
……
傍晚时分。
学院的训练课室结束，夜离殇带着云绒狐往家的方向走去。

回到家中。
夜离殇将小背包放下，拿出幽鳞青蛇的御兽蛋，放在茶几上，又拿出几颗御兽口粮，做完这一切，夜离殇就轻车熟路地往厨房的方向走去。
“离殇，今晚训练暂停，我带你去个地方，采购一点好东西。”
龙疏寒拿着一杯水从卧室中走出，淡淡开口。
“去一个地方？”
“龙阿姨，我们要去哪啊？”
夜离殇一边做事，一边询问着。
“海城黑市。”
“一个黑色交易市场，里面鱼龙混杂，但几乎什么都有，包括一些官方禁止售卖的东西，都可以在海城黑市中买到。”
“剩下的东西，我到时候再告诉你。”
龙疏寒喝了一口水，就在餐桌旁坐下。
“好的，龙阿姨。”
夜离殇答应一声后，就继续做饭。
不一会，晚饭做好，夜离殇和龙疏寒两人，在享用完晚饭后，就起身前去做准备。
夜离殇将幽鳞青蛇的御兽蛋，放入背包中，将云绒狐抱起来，就往门口的方向走去。
“把雪球收入御兽空间吧。”
“海城黑市那个地方，不方便你一直抱着它。”
龙疏寒站在门口，等待着夜离殇。
“嗷嗷。”
夜离殇答应一声，就将云绒狐收入手臂上的御兽纹路中。

这还是她第一次将云绒狐收入御兽空间。
平时由于云绒狐体型小巧可爱的缘故，夜离殇基本上都是抱着，或是让它待在自己肩膀上的。
走出家门，龙疏寒将提前准备好的一个面具递给夜离殇。
“等会进入海城黑市的时候，记得戴上。”
content_en:
"This is not good, teacher."
Ye Lishang blinked his eyes and said something bad, but his hand was not slow at all.
"Nothing bad."
"You are the only student in the academy with S-level beastmaster talent. People in other classes will probably pay more attention to you by then."
"The teacher doesn't have high requirements for you, as long as you can enter the top ten in the secret realm ranking."
Ling Canghai's expression was serious.
Hmm~
Among the entire class seven, the one with the best talent is Ye Lishang.
Apart from Ye Lishang, the most talented students were only a few students with C-level talents. Ling Canghai felt that it was unrealistic to expect those students with C-level talents to enter the top ten, so it was better to put all his hopes on Ye Lishang.
With S-level beast master talent and the fact that the students in the seven classes are all freshmen, Ye Lishang still has a great advantage among them.
In addition, Ye Li Shang's Yun Rong Hu is now at the third level, firmly standing at the forefront of the freshmen. As long as he works hard these days, under normal circumstances, Ling Canghai feels that there is a high possibility that Ye Li Shang will be able to compete with others.
Of course, this is only under normal circumstances, and it does not rule out that students from other classes are deliberately targeted for ranking.
"Well, I will work hard then."
Ye Lishang nodded slightly and scanned the list one by one.
Among the people in the first class, there is a person named Qian Ning, whose beast control is the same as hers, which is level three, and the rest of the beast control are all level two. Judging from the level of beast control alone, the rest of them are a little lower than her.
"Come on then, the teacher will take good care of you."
After Ling Canghai encouraged him, he walked forward to watch the first person's training.
…
Late afternoon.
The academy's training class was over, and Ye Lishang took Yunrong Hu towards home.
Return home.
Ye Li Shang put down his small backpack, took out the green snake's egg, put it on the coffee table, and took out a few pieces of animal ration. After doing all this, Ye Li Shang walked in the direction of the kitchen with ease.
"Li Shang, training is suspended tonight. I will take you to a place to buy some good things."
Long Shuhan walked out of the bedroom with a glass of water and spoke calmly.
"Going somewhere?"
"Aunt Long, where are we going?"
Ye Lishang asked while doing things.
"Haicheng Black Market."
"A black trading market with a mixed bag of fish and dragons, but almost everything, including some officially prohibited items, can be purchased in the Haicheng black market."
"I'll tell you the rest when the time comes."
Long Shuhan took a sip of water and sat down at the dining table.
"Okay, Aunt Long."
After Ye Lishang agreed, he continued cooking.
After a while, dinner was ready, and Ye Lishang and Long Shuhan got up to make preparations after enjoying their dinner.
Ye Lishang put the green snake's egg into his backpack, picked up the cloud fox, and walked towards the door.
"Put the snowball into the beast control space."
"Haicheng Black Market is a place where it's not convenient for you to hold it all the time."
Long Shuhan stood at the door, waiting for Ye Lishang.
"Ouch."
Ye Lishang agreed and put the Yunrong Fox into the beast-controlling pattern on his arm.
This is the first time that she has brought Yunrong Fox into the beast control space.
Usually, due to the small and cute size of the Yunrong Fox, Yeli Shang usually hugs it or lets it stay on his shoulders.
After walking out of the house, Long Shuhan handed a mask he had prepared in advance to Ye Lishang.
"Remember to wear it when you enter the black market in Haicheng later."
